metas.name: Parks and Recreation
metas.description: This highly uplifting and hilarious workplace mockumentary has the same warmth and incredible ensemble dynamic as Ted Lasso and Community.

metas.name: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
metas.description: A fast-paced, incredibly comforting cop comedy with lovable characters that fits perfectly alongside New Girl and Scrubs.

metas.name: Arrested Development
metas.description: Featuring brilliant, layer-cake meta-jokes and eccentric characters, this is a must-watch for fans of Community's clever writing.

metas.name: Schitt's Creek
metas.description: An incredibly cozy, uplifting, and funny fish-out-of-water comedy that mirrors the heartwarming growth found in Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Bob's Burgers
metas.description: A delightful, quirky, and comforting animated sitcom about a loving family, perfect for fans of King of the Hill and The Simpsons.

metas.name: Archer
metas.description: A highly-stylized, witty, and cynical animated comedy that will appeal greatly to fans of Rick and Morty and Futurama.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: This mockumentary about vampire roommates is absurdly funny and features the same chaotic, dry humor as It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia.

metas.name: The IT Crowd
metas.description: A classic British comedy full of geek culture and socially awkward situations, ideal for fans of Peep Show and Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Taskmaster
metas.description: An incredibly joyful and hilarious British comedy game show that serves as the ultimate low-stakes comfort and background viewing.

metas.name: Modern Family
metas.description: An easy-watching, heartwarming, and consistently funny mockumentary that is perfect for relaxing after a long day.

metas.name: Abbott Elementary
metas.description: A warm, witty, and optimistic mockumentary sitcom that brings the wholesome, comforting energy of Ted Lasso to a public school setting.

metas.name: Ghosts (UK)
metas.description: A lovely, cozy British sitcom about a young couple sharing a country house with a chaotic group of historical ghosts.

metas.name: Derry Girls
metas.description: A wonderfully chaotic and hilarious comedy about teenagers growing up in Northern Ireland, capturing the rapid-fire laughs of sitcoms like Community.

metas.name: The Inbetweeners
metas.description: If you enjoy the agonizing, cringeworthy, and deeply British humor of Peep Show, this teen comedy is a perfect match.

metas.name: Spaced
metas.description: A cult classic British sitcom packed with pop-culture references, sci-fi nods, and surreal comedy, ideal for fans of Community and Futurama.

metas.name: Flight of the Conchords
metas.description: A charming and quirky musical comedy about two New Zealand musicians in New York, sharing the dry, indie sensibility of Master of None.

metas.name: Better Off Ted
metas.description: A brilliant and underrated corporate satire that shares the sharp wit, fast pacing, and eccentric workplace vibes of Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Kim's Convenience
metas.description: A sweet, easy-to-watch, and funny family sitcom that offers excellent comfort viewing in the vein of New Girl.

metas.name: The Orville
metas.description: A sci-fi comedy-drama that captures the optimistic, adventure-of-the-week charm of Doctor Who and the humor of Futurama.

metas.name: Resident Alien
metas.description: A quirky sci-fi comedy about an alien trying to blend into a small town, matching the eccentric sci-fi mystery vibe of Dirk Gently.

metas.name: Pushing Daisies
metas.description: A whimsical, visually stunning, and sweet forensic fairy tale that is pure, colorful comfort food for the soul.

metas.name: Psych
metas.description: An incredibly lighthearted, funny detective show built on pop-culture references and amazing buddy chemistry, perfect for a relaxing binge.

metas.name: Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt
metas.description: An incredibly bright, colorful, and fast-paced comedy about relentless optimism, created by Tina Fey.

metas.name: Broad City
metas.description: A hilarious, energetic, and stoner-friendly female buddy comedy that fans of New Girl and Silicon Valley will love.

metas.name: Cougar Town
metas.description: Created by the mind behind Scrubs, this cozy, wine-soaked ensemble comedy is packed with physical humor and heartwarming friendships.

metas.name: Solar Opposites
metas.description: Co-created by the minds behind Rick and Morty, this high-concept sci-fi animated sitcom is full of hilarious alien hijinks.

metas.name: Gravity Falls
metas.description: A wonderfully smart, funny, and comforting animated mystery-adventure series that appeals to all ages, ideal for fans of Futurama.

metas.name: Curb Your Enthusiasm
metas.description: This legendary cringe comedy features the same hilariously petty, selfish behavior and intricate plotting as It's Always Sunny and Peep Show.

metas.name: Party Down
metas.description: A brilliant cult comedy about a cynical team of Hollywood caterers, matching the deadpan humor of Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Veep
metas.description: A lightning-fast, highly profane, and incredibly funny political satire that shares the sharp ensemble wit of Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Our Flag Means Death
metas.description: A highly lighthearted, romantic pirate comedy that perfectly captures the whimsical adventure of One Piece and the warmth of Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Mythic Quest
metas.description: Set in a video game studio, this comedy co-created by the It's Always Sunny team beautifully blends sharp satire with genuine heart.

metas.name: The Venture Bros.
metas.description: A brilliant, nerd-culture animated parody of retro action-adventure cartoons that fans of Rick and Morty and One Piece will adore.

metas.name: Detroiters
metas.description: An incredibly wholesome, silly, and joyful buddy comedy about two best friends running a low-budget ad agency.

metas.name: Lovesick
metas.description: A charming, sweet, and genuinely funny British romantic comedy-drama that feels like a cozy, transatlantic cousin to New Girl.

metas.name: Extraordinary
metas.description: A fresh, hilarious, and heartwarming British comedy set in a world where everyone gets a superpower except the main character.

metas.name: Mob Psycho 100
metas.description: From the creator of One-Punch Man, this beautifully animated show blends spectacular psychic battles with an incredibly heartwarming, wholesome story.

metas.name: The Outlaws
metas.description: A lighthearted, funny, and engaging British crime comedy-drama from Stephen Merchant, capturing the scrappy charm of Brassic.

metas.name: Fresh Meat
metas.description: Written by the creators of Peep Show, this hilarious comedy follows a chaotic group of university housemates in the UK.

metas.name: Disenchantment
metas.description: An animated fantasy-comedy from Matt Groening (creator of Futurama and The Simpsons), offering cozy, satirical fantasy adventure.
